name: blender-3d-team
description: A professional 3D asset team as Claude Code skills, driving Blender through Python and the Blender MCP: art director (brief and references), modeler, texture artist, tech artist/QA and delivery. Takes an asset from a verbal idea to a reviewed, exported, documented package (0 -> 1): intake interview, approved brief, blockout, modeling, UV, procedural or baked PBR textures, render review loops, technical audit, export presets per engine (glTF, Unity, Unreal, Godot, Roblox, web, USD) and a delivery packet.
